p7_b3.ocr: This growth trajectory is indicative of shifting consumer preferences towards cost-effective alternatives, driving retailers to optimize their store footprints strategically. Notably, the Fashion & Leather category has also shown promising performance, with a market share of 20% and total sales reaching CHF500M. In this context, optimizing store presence is critical; for instance, the Household Goods segment recorded a sales figure of CHF180M alongside a growth rate of 8% YoY.

p7_b4.ocr: Furthermore, the overall expansion in these categories necessitates a thorough analysis of market dynamics, including an evaluation of the competitive landscape and consumer behavior trends. The importance of optimizing the store footprint is underscored by the fact that a mere 50 stores can yield substantial returns, with an impressive performance metric of 11.0%. As brands and retailers navigate this evolving landscape, the focus remains on enhancing their offerings while ensuring the effective allocation of resources to maximize market share.
